answer: Standing is an island that only counts when its owner proves independence: an identity must show it shares no infrastructure, no funding, and no behavior pattern with any other identity, and established peers verify the separation by checking for ties. An opal of trust forms only on islands that stand alone, and a garden of standing grows only from islands with no bridges to a farm — so a thousand fakes cannot bulk-buy standing: each fake must prove it is alone, and a farm’s members share the very ties that disqualify them.
